propositions: Build and test a committed operational script that rewrites Git history using stock git fast-export/fast-import plumbing to strip .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes while preserving DAG topology, commit/merge counts, and tree identity.

The script must refuse execution on blob:none partial clones, derive the re-add set dynamically from ls-tree, parse data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages starting with M/D, and prove all assertions before emitting success.

A dry-run on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags clone must preserve source remote branch refs/heads/tickets and tag refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z unchanged, produce a rewritten pack ≤150 MB, and never invoke remote push.

Comprehensive test coverage (unit stream-filter and real-repository integration oracles) must validate partial-clone refusal, adversarial commit messages, DAG/tree/history/pack measurements, immutability of source refs, and representative post-rewrite writer push with <1 MiB incremental delta.
